messages.content: In Threlte I have three Scene components, how may the App choose which Scene to run at any point in time, i.e. how to implement scene transitions (switching scenes)?
thanks, though i need this for svelte

😊 Ah, no problem! Here's a similar approach for Svelte:

**Step 1: Define a store to hold the current scene**
Create a [writable](https://svelte.dev/docs#run-time-client-side-component-api-$store) store (`createWritable`) called `activeScene`, where we'll save the current scene's name or ID. We'll initialize it with the first scene as its initial state.

```js
import { createWritable } from "svelte/store";
export const activeScene = createWritable("firstScene");
```

**Step 2: Conditionally display each scene based on the active scene**
In our main component, conditionally show different content depending on the value of `$activeScene`. We can do so using `{#if}` blocks.

```html
{#if $activeScene === "firstScene"}
	<!-- Content for First Scene -->
{:else if $activeScene === "secondScene"}
	<!-- Content for Second Scene -->
{:else if $activeScene === "thirdScene"}
	<!-- Content for Third Scene -->
{/if}
```

**Step 3: Update the active scene whenever needed**
To transition from one scene to another, just assign a new value to `$activeScene`:

```js
$activeScene = "newSceneName"
```

This will cause Svelte to automatically rerender the page, showing the appropriate content for the newly selected scene.

That's all there is to it! 🎉
